text: The growth rate is calculated by taking the average of the annual growth rates from 2014-2017. For instance, the growth rate for TSA Agent State Enrollments from 2014-2015 is 0.066% = (182,231/182,111)-1, 2015 to 2016 is -6.94%, and from 2016 to 2017 is 0.091%. This results in an overall average of -2.26% = (0.066% + 6.94% + 0.091%) / 3.

text: TSA calculates a compensation factor (1.5072) to inflate the hourly wage to account for non-compensation component costs of employee compensation (such as retirement and health benefits, among others). The compensation factor is calculated by dividing the full compensation ($28.11) for private sector transportation workers by the wage and salary component ($18.65). of their compensation (1.5072 = $28.11 ÷ $18.65).
